summary: Rach2 builds etude by its TinyCC recipe, and the POSIX executor, built the same way, passes its test there; the scenario is machine/etudeexec_scenario.c and the script it runs on Rach2 machine/etudeexec_guest.sh

cases.behavior: os-real, booted with a second disk that is a tar archive of etude's source, the executor's test and the files they need, unpacks it into a tmpfs as root, and there etude's provision_version.sh builds a version by the TinyCC recipe and then reuses it, the version's record names the platform rach2 and the recipe's -D__rach2__, the built etude's check --selftest and check history pass, and the executor's test, compiled with the version's compiler and flags, passes with every row run, the subreaper's among them, while no etude program asks for a system call the kernel lacks

inputs.archive: tools/etude, utils/sha256.c and .h, tests/host/etude_exec_hosttest.c, its compat files, tests/auxvprobe.c and tests/cases/machine/etudeexec_guest.sh

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk copies and the evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot a copy of the os-real disk, with the archive as the second disk, to the console's login prompt
log in at the console as root with the demo password
mount a tmpfs at /tmp/etudeexec and unpack the archive there from /dev/disk1 with tar
run etudeexec_guest.sh from the archive, read its results and the boot's trace of missing system calls, and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: root logs in at the console with the demo password and its shell prompts
tar unpacks the archive from the raw second disk into a tmpfs
provision_version.sh -l builds a version of the unpacked source with the TinyCC recipe
a second provision_version.sh -l reuses the version it built, with the same key
the version's record names the platform rach2 and the machine's architecture
the version's record gives the recipe's flags with -D__rach2__
the version's etude check --selftest passes on etude's fixtures
the version's etude check history accepts the whole example history
etude check history exits 2 for the example history with its last record cut
the version's compiler and flags, with the test's own host-deps and host-cflags, build the executor's test
the executor's test exits 0, says that it passed, and names no row it did not run, the subreaper's among them
the boot's trace names no system call the kernel lacks that execcheck or etude asked for

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended
etudeexec_guest.sh has built etude and run the executor's test on Rach2

native.reason: the case reads the archive of etude's source from a raw second disk of the machine, which an installed machine does not have
